Address.TABLE_COMMENT: Street address information for customers, employees, and vendors.

AddressType.TABLE_COMMENT: Types of addresses stored in the Address table.

AWBuildVersion.TABLE_COMMENT: Current version number of the AdventureWorks 2014 sample database.

BillOfMaterials.TABLE_COMMENT: Items required to make bicycles and bicycle subassemblies. It identifies the heirarchical relationship between a parent product and its components.

BusinessEntity.TABLE_COMMENT: Source of the ID that connects vendors, customers, and employees with address and contact information.

BusinessEntityAddress.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping customers, vendors, and employees to their addresses.

BusinessEntityContact.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping stores, vendors, and employees to people

ContactType.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table containing the types of business entity contacts.

CountryRegion.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table containing the ISO standard codes for countries and regions.

CountryRegionCurrency.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping ISO currency codes to a country or region.

Culture.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table containing the languages in which some AdventureWorks data is stored.

Currency.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table containing standard ISO currencies.

Customer.TABLE_COMMENT: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.

DatabaseLog.TABLE_COMMENT: Audit table tracking all DDL changes made to the AdventureWorks database. Data is captured by the database trigger ddlDatabaseTriggerLog.

Department.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table containing the departments within the Adventure Works Cycles company.

EmailAddress.TABLE_COMMENT: Where to send a person email.

Employee.TABLE_COMMENT: Employee information such as salary, department, and title.

ErrorLog.TABLE_COMMENT: Audit table tracking errors in the the AdventureWorks database that are caught by the CATCH block of a TRY...CATCH construct. Data is inserted by stored procedure dbo.uspLogError when it is executed from inside the CATCH block of a TRY...CATCH construct.

JobCandidate.TABLE_COMMENT: Résumés submitted to Human Resources by job applicants.

Person.TABLE_COMMENT: Human beings involved with AdventureWorks: employees, customer contacts, and vendor contacts.

PersonCreditCard.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping people to their credit card information in the CreditCard table.

PersonPhone.TABLE_COMMENT: Telephone number and type of a person.

PhoneNumberType.TABLE_COMMENT: Type of phone number of a person.

Product.TABLE_COMMENT: Products sold or used in the manfacturing of sold products.

ProductCostHistory.TABLE_COMMENT: Changes in the cost of a product over time.

ProductDocument.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping products to related product documents.

ProductListPriceHistory.TABLE_COMMENT: Changes in the list price of a product over time.

ProductModelIllustration.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping product models and illustrations.

ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping product descriptions and the language the description is written in.

ProductProductPhoto.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping products and product photos.

ProductReview.TABLE_COMMENT: Customer reviews of products they have purchased.

ProductVendor.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping vendors with the products they supply.

PurchaseOrderDetail.TABLE_COMMENT: Individual products associated with a specific purchase order. See PurchaseOrderHeader.

PurchaseOrderHeader.TABLE_COMMENT: General purchase order information. See PurchaseOrderDetail.

SalesOrderDetail.TABLE_COMMENT: Individual products associated with a specific sales order. See SalesOrderHeader.

SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping sales orders to sales reason codes.

SalesReason.TABLE_COMMENT: Lookup table of customer purchase reasons.

SalesTerritoryHistory.TABLE_COMMENT: Sales representative transfers to other sales territories.

ShoppingCartItem.TABLE_COMMENT: Contains online customer orders until the order is submitted or cancelled.

SpecialOfferProduct.TABLE_COMMENT: Cross-reference table mapping products to special offer discounts.

TransactionHistory.TABLE_COMMENT: Record of each purchase order, sales order, or work order transaction year to date.

Vendor.TABLE_COMMENT: Companies from whom Adventure Works Cycles purchases parts or other goods.
